result.title: Reason First, Retrieve What Matters: Hypothesis-Guided Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding
result.summary: Long video understanding requires models to identify and reason over sparse, temporally distributed evidence within limited frame budgets. Existing keyframe selection methods typically retrieve query-relevant frames from a densely sampled candidate set before inference. However, global image-text matching incurs unnecessary computation when a small set of uniformly sampled frames already provides sufficient evidence. Query relevance alone may also overlook evidence that distinguishes competing answers, while one-shot selection offers no opportunity to correct earlier selection errors. We propose HypoKFS, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that couples keyframe selection with iterative inference by multimodal large language models (MLLMs). HypoKFS first reasons over sparsely sampled frames to construct an initial hypothesis space. The resulting answer distribution determines whether additional frame selection is needed. When needed, the retained hypotheses guide the selection of discriminative frames, followed by renewed inference and hypothesis refinement. This iterative process directs additional visual computation toward unresolved hypotheses while avoiding unnecessary global frame matching. Experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple MLLM backbones. HypoKFS improves accuracy by up to 6.7 percentage points and achieves 72.9% accuracy on Video-MME at only 1.3% of the reference frame-hypothesis matching cost.

AI.brief_summary: 提出无需训练、可即插即用的 HypoKFS 框架：先在稀疏采样帧上推理构建初始假设空间，由答案分布判断是否需补充选帧，再由保留假设引导挑选有区分度的帧并重新推理以精化假设。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“答案分布决定是否继续取帧”的机制与 LOOK/STOP 的收益成本权衡直接相关，用竞争假设筛选视觉证据也可供核查视觉证据筛选与停止决策的联系；但方法完全在文本假设层面，未涉及 latent 状态，需判断其可迁移性。
